notes.title: White Pearl Patch 2.10 Notes - Quest Journal Update
notes.content:
[h1]White Pearl Patch 2.10[/h1]

The patch will increase White Pearl's file size by 9MB.
[b]Patch 2.10 adds a quest journal to White Pearl, along with other additions and changes.[/b]
This will be the last major update to the game.
Please check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916210/Fabrication]Fabrication[/url] if you enjoyed White Pearl!

[h1]Major Features and Additions[/h1]

[list][*][b]A Quest Journal has been implemented in the game.[/b]
[/list][i]*You will need to start the game from the beginning to obtain the Journal and for the quest objectives that come with the Journal to take effect.[/i]

The Quest Journal is a new, highly requested item that has finally been added to the game.
You will be able to track both the progress of the main story and side quests with the
Quest Journal, complete with new flavour text for all quests - in addition to all associated objectives as you unlock them and progress through the quest and the ability to see the rewards you will get from doing a quest.

The Quest Journal is obtained at the start of the game and can be accessed from your
Inventory, Key Items menu. To scroll down on the quest description and objective window, select the quest in the menu and use the analog stick/arrow keys.

[h2]Picture Examples[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31354862/a29a9048f5aff83bb6257ac77d68032be25e26ec.png[/img]

The Quest Journal is accessible in your Inventory -> Key Items menu. It's given to you at the start of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31354862/b2655d3a7de44033e73d51d0bf974f9c4d1d4ef5.png[/img]

This is a basic example of a quest. Main story quests and side quests have different icons and colour separating them apart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31354862/2e66af507d5886e85b9093c91d0211fabdf23c33.png[/img]

A lot of review feedback detailed that White Pearl's story was hard to follow, so I used this opportunity to make a synopsis for when a lot of stuff does happen in the main story, and there is perspective switching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31354862/318cc45a7b80250760c5df82a3fbea7c45708095.png[/img]

This is one last example of a main story quest. Some objectives only appear as you go through them. The idea is that you'll check the journal if you're lost or confused on what is happening, or if you would just like to read more.

You expect some smaller QOL text changes as well, like the implementation of colours on equipment values.
For the quest journal to work properly, you'll have to restart your game, so I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31354862/363a86a8dc4c10aa03c4f7065673ea496d83c7c9.png[/img]

An example of the new equipment screen.

[list][*][b]All characters in the game can now equip up to two separate accessories through the addition of a second accessory slot.[/b]
[/list]

Changes to accommodate a second accessory slot:
[list][*]Accessories are no longer optimised for the character's gear when pressing the "Eq. Priority Stats" button in the Character Equipment menu.
[*]The programming of the equip menu has been slightly adjusted:
- The game will now more clearly display empty equipment slots
- The game now display MaximumHP and MaximumMP in the "Current Stats and Differences" board.
- To compromise for the aforementioned change, the name of the character you are equipping, which is displayed in the "Current Stats and Differences" board, is now removed.
- A scroll option has been added in the equipment menu, for accessing the new slot.
[/list]

[i]*The addition of the second accessory slot is effective throughout the game regardless of where you have saved and you will have no need to start the game from the beginning.

*You can equip any and all types of accessories that the character can use in the Accessory 2 slot, just like the one slot you had before the 2.10 patch.[/i] 

[h1]Patch 2.10 Notes - Minor Changes[/h1]

[list][*]Colour tones have been added on all armour and weapon tooltips to better display the advantages and disadvantages of each item.

[*]Critical hits are now accompanied by a "CRITICAL!" pop-up above the damage indicator in addition to the already animated text.
[/list]

[u]Equipment Adjustments[/u]
[b]Glided Fisticuffs[/b] 
- Now increases DEF by 10.

[b]Four Leaf Clover[/b]
- Now increases ATK and AGI by 5.

[u]Dialogue Adjustments[/u]
In certain scenes, some spelling errors have been corrected and flow of certain dialogue is corrected to sound better.

Additional dialogue has been added to the scene while under the second objective of the main story quest "Rough and Tumble".

[u]Event Adjustments[/u]

- The programming and flags of several events in the game have been adjusted with the addition of a Quest Journal, in order to ensure compatibility with all quests and their associated objectives.

[b]When selecting U'vharr's Perspective in Chapter 10...[/b]
- Now tells the user: "This quest covers main story events happening after "Picking Up the Pieces".

[b]When selecting Pearlto's Perspective in Chapter 10...[/b]
- Now tells the user: "This quest covers main story events happening
after "What Bandits Do Best".

[u]Battle Encounter Adjustments[/u]

[b]Battle encounters of "A Slimy Situation" side quest, the Church of Divinia cellar side quest.[/b]
- You can no longer get K.Oed in these fights.

[b]Boss fight of "A Slimy Situation" side quest, the Church of Divinia cellar side quest.[/b]
- You can no longer get K.Oed in this fight.

[u]Enemy Adjustments[/u]
[b]Cellar Slime[/b]
- EXP received increased from 5 to 18.

[u]Quest Adjustments[/u]
[b]"A Slimy Situation" side quest, the Church of Divinia cellar side quest.[/b]
- You now only need to kill 4 slimes to pass instead of 8.

[u]Location Adjustments[/u]
[b]Church of Divinia[/b]

Treasure chest rewards adjusted:

Chest at top: Reward adjusted 25G to 150G.
Chest at right: Reward adjusted from x1 Potion to x3 Eye Drops.
Chest at bottom: Reward adjusted from 10G to 100G.


[b]Inns now have a name in the game, as follows:[/b]
Falcon: "The Place of Prophecy"
Ancarna: "The Parting Sands"
Prevesta: "The Blue God's Blessing"
Valen: "Those who Rule High Above"
Jelesta: "The Determination of Man"
Lucae: "Those who Survived the Fourth Calamity"
Kolan: "The Sky Crafters"

This concludes the Patch 2.10 notes.

Thank you for playing!

Harry,

Developer & Publisher of White Pearl and Fabrication

notes.title: Major News Update - Fabrication
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been a while since I updated the news page, and I'd just like to update it for posterity's sake in-case anyone still uses this for the main source of information.

This blog post will cover [b]NEW[/b] news regarding Fabrication, the next game in the Chronicles of Ottrea series, that has not been covered anywhere else.
If you [i]do[/i] want frequent updates, please make sure to follow the series [url=https://twitter.com/ottrea]Twitter[/url]!

[h1]Main Topic 1: Fabrication Release Date[/h1]
[b]Fabrication is set to release at the end of 2020 / early 2021![/b]

Previously, I was really set on releasing the game at the end of 2020 as part of White Pearl's 3rd anniversary but, the sound team needs to catch up with everything! And I would really like the extra time to play-test the game and turn it inside out. Especially looking at White Pearl... a big problem upon release was bugs and I really don't want something like that repeated again, so I want to do it right. So I am aiming for this release window. A more exact date will be revealed soon, but you don't have long to wait anymore, so don't worry!

Another announcement... the Steam page is coming soon! Due to COVID19, page and build reviews are taking a lot longer than expected. Which is no problem really... because I've been busy making the game. And I actually haven't even bothered to send in my request for submission yet [i](laughs)[/i].

[h1]Main Topic 2: Fabrication Game Details[/h1]

If you've played White Pearl, the best way I can describe Fabrication is that the game is basically that... but improved and better to play!

[i]Main Features of Fabrication:[/i]

- The story of the game takes place before the events of White Pearl
- 15-20 hours of playtime
- I'll be implementing lots more achievements this time, so I want interested players to aim for them!
- There's a Quest Log. Yep... that's a main feature. Because it was so highly requested from White Pearl.
- Over 20 side-quests and activities in total to complete in addition to the engaging story
- Crafting system
- Fishing system
- Trading system
- Reputation, relationship and fame system*

* More detail on these mechanics will be revealed in either the store page or as you play the actual game to understand how they work. 

...And that's it! I'm really looking forward to getting this game out there and in people's hands. By the way, I'm still looking for testers. If you want to apply, [url=https://hgdb2.home.blog/2020/05/16/testers-needed-fabrication-2020/]check this blog post out[/url].

*I'm currently experiencing a huge influx of e-mails, so I might miss your application. I'll be checking them more carefully over the next month though, even if you sent something out back in May. I'm really sorry for the delay, but I'll try to get back in time. Thank you!

[u]If you're looking for video footage of the game;[/u]

Launch Trailer (with some new footage): https://youtu.be/erVkHlQjoYY

Battle Gameplay Trailer: https://youtu.be/f6pdvn68kHM

Puzzle Gameplay Trailer: https://youtu.be/11Z0KT4q3Ug

Harry,
Director & Producer of White Pearl and Fabrication

notes.title: Testers Needed - Fabrication 2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

I have been developing Fabrication, the next game in the Chronicles of Ottrea series, for quite a while now. I have reached a stage where I want to release the game for public testing.

Fabrication is a commercial prequel to White Pearl. Watch these trailers and read the description of the video to get a proper idea on what the game is about.

Update! Store page now available: https://store.steampowered.com/app/916210/Fabrication/

[h2]Fabrication Announcement Trailer - July 2018[/h2]

[previewyoutube=uPE6cXCpq44;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Fabrication Development Trailer - May 2019[/h2]

[previewyoutube=6ZKAcMlDTU4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]So how do I get involved?[/h2]

To know about the whole testing process and what I'm doing, read this blog post:
https://hgdb2.home.blog/2020/05/16/testers-needed-fabrication-2020/

I've also released some screenshots of Fabrication on my Twitter, showcasing the story and gameplay. I am making Fabrication to stand apart from White Pearl in it's own unique way. Even though the stories are connected, the game can be enjoyed as a standalone experience. This game will also feature a continuation to White Pearl's story and characters.
My aim for this game is to improve on the aspects that received criticism from White Pearl while challenging myself to make something new. 

Please enjoy White Pearl in the meantime. Thank you for all the reviews as it has pushed me to make something new. I would really appreciate it if you share this game around and buy Fabrication when it releases. As for when it releases? That's a secret.

notes.title: News Update - Fabrication #2
notes.content:
Today it's been 1 year and 5 months since White Pearl released, and a lot has changed to the game since then.
Despite that, behind the scenes, I've been working on the game's prequel, Fabrication, which is still just an extra hobby ontop of everything else. 
It seems that a lot of people are interested, though... 

Regardless, there is some news to share. 
A week ago, I released a new trailer for the game, showcasing it's development details, and gameplay details and footage.

https://youtu.be/6ZKAcMlDTU4

I hope you enjoy! Be sure to read the description. 

For this game, like White Pearl, it will be solely developed by myself, and it will take lots of time. I can't stress that enough. White Pearl took 3 years to make, and this game might take around the same amount of time because I don't have as much free time as I did then.

notes.title: White Pearl Patch 2.0 - Release Dates & Information
notes.content:
In order to facilitate a smoother experience for new players before the release of Fabrication - Patch 2.0 of White Pearl will be released in two parts.

[h1]White Pearl - Patch 2.0 Part I: Balance and System Adjustments[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/fd5beeedb28bcf5779287b68beea51fa102aec61.png[/img]

[b]Release date: Tuesday 16th April 2019[/b]

View the changes to come with this part of the patch here: https://elyswer.itch.io/white-pearlrpg/devlog/52479/patch-20-notes

[h1]White Pearl - Patch 2.0 Part II: Compatibility Patch for Fabrication[/h1]

[b]Release date: ----[/b]

* More details for Part II of Patch 2.0 will release when Fabrication emerges on Steam.

[h1]Notable changes coming in Part 1 of Patch 2.0[/h1]

[b]Skippable Cutscenes[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/144c084195d5e16947695976ede39f525b861624.png[/img]

Most cutscenes can now be skipped by pressing LB (gamepad) / S (keyboard) during the event. Completion of the game is not required to skip cutscenes.

* Because of this change, permanent changes to events have been added, so it will be required to create a new game save file in order to play through the game and make use of this.

[b]Crafting System Extension: Reinforcement of Shields and Bucklers[/b]

By reinforcing shields and bucklers, you increase their main parameters. However, you are also able to add additional effects to them using Aura Essence.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/1ba4bb1398251543bc4222632dd17dd1405f5e3c.png[/img]

[i]View the tutorial and walkthrough on this system on the official White Pearl 2.0 Patch Notes: https://elyswer.itch.io/white-pearlrpg/devlog/52479/patch-20-notes[/i]

[b]Trading System Extension: Aura Essence[/b]

A new system has been added to trading: exchanging certain Aura Essence for Aura Essence - Fire and Ice.

The system is available once crafting is unlocked, and is intended for use in conjunction with the newly added crafting feature.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/310d1ffeefee23c23abc139f0d530a3a7d775c44.png[/img]

[i]View the tutorial and walkthrough on this system on the official White Pearl 2.0 Patch Notes: https://elyswer.itch.io/white-pearlrpg/devlog/52479/patch-20-notes[/i]


[h1]Other Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The optimisation of the game has improved, thereby reducing/eliminating lag in several instances. 2.0 brings a smoother experience to White Pearl!

[*] Many more changes are present in Patch 2.0 Part I which greatly affect new players' experience - making it, overall, an easier and more enjoyable game with greater depth.

[*] It is advised for existing players to wait until Fabrication releases before re-entering the world of Ottrea - as those products will content suitable to long-time players; being a new game within the White Pearl universe.

[*] The whole guide has been updated with these changes and the Chronicle Edition DLC will update after several weeks Patch 2.0 Part I releases.

[/list]

Thanks for reading and for playing!

notes.title: Announcing White Pearl Patch 2.0, scheduled for release in 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/c4f924afbe6c7ad5b9947c5de826fd121206362c.png[/img]

This is an announcement as part of White Pearl's 1st anniversary since release (October - December 2017).

Patch 2.0 will bring huge changes to White Pearl's game balance and adds new features to the game (such as extending the crafting system).

[h1][u]Detailing the Changes[/u][/h1]

[i]The following pictures are taken from the White Pearl 2.0 patch notes. When the patch has finished development, a seperate announcement will be made with the link to these patch notes - allowing players to peruse over the patch notes in their entirety.[/i]

[u]New Features - what will they entail?[/u]

[list]
[*]An extension to the crafting system will be added:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/3a3560c9ef66021bab6cdf1340ed3882e9911ff4.png[/img]

With the implentation of this new system, new types of shields will be added:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/0481c46884c84ad2484240bfa519866bbe150b40.png[/img]

- Quest rewards will be adjusted to better reward the player for their time and effort.
A Quest Log [b]may[/b] be added to the game. Because of the addition of the Luna Engine, White Pearl's backend UI engine, adding new UI scripts is difficult because it is not always guaranteed to work - and very few are compatible. I ask for your patience on this matter.
[/list]

[i]* More changes and additions will be made as development of the patch progresses.[/i]

[u]Game Balance - what will be affected?[/u]

[list]
[*]All types of items will be readjusted.

[*]New weapons and armors will be added, and existing armors will be rebalanced to allow players the freedom of choice, without a straight vertical progression of stats.

[*]In general, many weapons will have their damage and additional effects boosted:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/67bf10033714cfa356b9046d79033245b28334b8.png[/img]

[i]* More changes and additions will be made as development of the patch progresses.[/i]

Lastly, the official guide will be updated with these changes accordingly, so there is no need to worry for in-accurate information.

notes.title: White Pearl Patch 1.0.9 - Echoes From the Past Calamity
notes.content:
These changes will greatly appeal to existing fans, but also ease in new ones.

The patch will be releasing this month - and maybe, once Fabrication releases, I might add some post-game content in White Pearl too. Depends if I feel up to the task!

Firstly, I'd like to point out a very important detail in the patch notes, and I'll specify it here: 

[u]Changes to Existing Events[/u]
- At both ending areas, it is possible to obtain the acheivements that have been added recently through a menu. This is so existing players will not have to replay the game fully.

notes.title: Major 1.0.8 Update; Balance Adjustments Detailed!
notes.content:
Hello! I made a few changes to some skills.
I'm not able to make changes to already existing enemies and items because it's all recorded in the guide now and I don't want to risk it becoming outdated.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/e06ec7a869dc7a6e90be2b1f436a581a70304bea.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]UPDATE NOTES (issued 20th Apr 2018):[/h1]

[u]General Actions[/u]

[b]Guard[/b]

- Now restores 2% of MaxHP and MP upon use.

[u]Pearlto - Paladin[/u]

[b]Provoke[/b]

- Now also adds the effect of "Cover" onto the user.
- Now has a cooldown of 2 turns.
- MP cost reduced from 10 to 5.

[b]Makeshift Medic[/b]

- Now grants a 1 turn resistance to the following effects:
 - Bleed
 - Fracture
The resistance will be bestowed regardless if the effects have been removed by the skill or not.

- MP cost reduced from 9 to 2.

[u]Katkin - Lancer[/u]

[b]Leaden Thrust[/b]

- Will now always inflict Reverse Hasten.
- Can now deal critical damage.

[b]Aspected Heal, Restore, Rejuvenate & Aspected Prayer and Rejuvenation[/b]

- Can now allow critical HP restore.

[u]Elyswer - Bard[/u]

[b]Song of Valor[/b]

- Charge time negated.

[b]Wide Volley[/b]

- Animation will now play on all enemies all at once.
- Charge time negated.

[b]Syncopation[/b]

- Now has a cooldown of 2 turns.

[u]Elrise - Pugilist[/u]

[b]Decoy[/b]

- Now also increases EVA by 20% for 3 turns.

[u]Cassopeia - Black Mage[/u]

[b]Magic Expose[/b]

- Base potency increased from 20 to 220.
  As such, the tooltop for the skill has been altered from "deals small dark 
  damage", to "deals moderate dark damage".

[b]Reverse Protect, Shell, Hasten[/b]

- Base potency increased from 25 to 80.

[b]Spark[/b] (also shared by Katkin)

- Base potency increased from 150 to 180.
  As such, the tooltop for the skill has been altered from "deals lightning 
  damage", to "deals reasonable lightning damage".

[u]Elsay - White Mage[/u]

[b]Round Swing[/b]

- Base potency increased from 125 to 225.
- Charge time negated.
- Can now allow critical damage.
- MP cost reduced from 22 to 18.

[b]Mend Body[/b]

- Now grants a 1 turn resistance to the following effects:
 - Bleed
 - Fracture
 - Crippled
The resistance will be bestowed regardless if the effects have been removed by the skill or not.

[b]Cure[/b]

- Now grants a 1 turn resistance to the following effects:
 - Poison
 - Blind
 - Silence
The resistance will be bestowed regardless if the effects have been removed by the skill or not.

[b]Revive[/b]

- HP% restored increased from 22 to 35.

[b]New skill added: Banish[/b] (was on the database before, but not added to skill lists).
- Deals high holy damage to one enemy. (base: 400)
- Has a cooldown of 3 turns.
- MP cost: 15
- Aquired by Elsay and Kurone at level 20. 
 *Players who have passed this level before the update will be unable to 
  aquire the new skill.

[b]Heal II, Restore II[/b]

- Can now allow critical HP restore.

[u]Kurone - Mythologist[/u]

- The cooldown timer has been removed from the following skills:
 - Holy Up
 - Dark Up
 - Fire Up
 - Ice Up
 - Wind Up
 - Earth Up

[b]Wind of Healing[/b]

- The base HP restore value has been increased from 180 to 360.
  As such, the tooltop for the skill has been altered from "slightly restore all 
  allies' HP", to "restores all allies' HP".
- The Lesser Hasten effect, has been replaced with "Hasten".
- Now costs 15 MP to use.

[b]Element[/b]

- Base potency increased from 150 to 180.
- Now decreases all elemental resistances by 10% upon effect.
- Now has a cooldown of 4 turns.
- Can now deal critical damage.

[u]U'vharr - Warrior[/u]

[b]Reverse Courage and Faith[/b]

- Base potency increased from 25 to 80.

[b]Beserk (shared with Walt)[/b]

- Defense reduction effect reduced from 35%, to 23%.

[u]Other Skills[/u]

[b]Expanding Horizons[/b]

- Now grants an additional turn the next turn.

[h1]End of Update Notes[/h1]

It may be late, but ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ - there's still a few people playing the game, so why not?
I changed what I felt needed changing. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Official Guide and Last Content Addition Released!
notes.content:
The complete official guide for White Pearl has been released:

Download:
https://elyswer.itch.io/white-pearlrpg

There's also another guide, written by a member of the community.
That guide focuses on story and sidequest walkthrough. It will be very useful for new players, so please check it out!

Two new locations have been added to the region of Kolan:

- Kolan Reaches
- Breka Town

These locations are accessible after Chapter 6. 
It is the last content addition for White Pearl.
I will still be bug fixing and making changes here and there.

The splash screen has been updated with the latest news and version of the game.
In addition, certain tooltips and victory quotes have been corrected.

Most importantly, I hope you enjoy the guide and it is of use to you.
Thank you for supporting White Pearl!

notes.title: An Official Guide is Now in Production!
notes.content:
Starting today, I have already begun production on a guide to White Pearl.

For the guide, I am aiming to include:

- A full inventory breakdown, listing where and how to get all the items in the game.
- A sidequest walkthrough
- A story walkthrough (if applicable)

Due to the amount of content in the game, I am sure I might miss or pass over some details, but I hope for it to be as complete as it can be. 

You can see what I've made so far: https://twitter.com/HarryBupBup/status/967767549428600833

I hope to have most of the guide complete by the end of March 2018, where I will either disclose further information, or release the guide if it's already finished.

UPDATE: I'm not going to do a story walkthrough because I think it's pointless and creates too much work for me to go through. Instead, I will do a boss walkthrough which I believe will be far more helpful. As for the guide, it's nearing inventory completion so it won't be long.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/9b9243b21e356a27fe318a7c75414dc3191cff72.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates to White Pearl (what I can and can't do)
notes.content:
Even though I went through several major updates to WP (on other pages) before the release of the game on Steam, there's still bugs left - I've managed to squash major ones, such as crashing, by the end of December.
[b]I am depending on players to report bugs in the "Bugs" subforums of the game, so I can keep patching fixes in.[/b] 
This year, I'm not sure how big the game will grow, but I will still be releasing content updates if needed.
However, there are a few things that I can't implement:

- Quest Log (too late on, because every player would be at different stages of the game right now).

- Resolution upgrade (I cannot extend the resolution to more than 640x480, as that is a violation of the software's agreement).

Regardless, I am still very happy with how well the game has done - and it's gone pretty much as I expected it to.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31354862/0f1b1ec9726d2c6a09975b4b96d44631b9677593.png[/img]
